## Intel announces $15B share sale to fund AI infrastructure buildout

A $15B equity raise is among the larger capital markets events for a semiconductor company; it signals management conviction in the AI buildout strategy but imposes near-term EPS dilution and places execution pressure squarely on Intel's foundry and AI product roadmap. The market's read on whether this is offensive investment or defensive survival will drive the stock reaction.

- Intel announced a $15 billion equity offering, explicitly framed as financing for AI infrastructure investment.
- This is a direct capital-structure event — material dilution for existing INTC shareholders.
- The AI buildout framing positions Intel as an active entrant in AI infrastructure, not merely a legacy CPU business.
- Corroborates the TSMC/Intel foundry-race headline (cluster 6f09a420d001399e) reporting the same raise in a competitive context.
